group.name: Railway (RRB / RRC / RPF)
group.intro: Zyada tar RRB exams ki fees ₹500 hai, jismein se ₹400 CBT 1 dene ke baad wapas mil jaate hain; SC, ST, ex-servicemen, PwBD, mahilayein, transgender, minorities aur economically backward classes ₹250 dete hain, jo CBT 1 ke baad poore wapas milte hain. Sirf ek regional RRB website par apply karein; exam 15 bhashaon mein hota hai. Haal ke RRB CBTs mein har galat answer par 1/3 mark katta hai.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.7.rule: CAPF aur Railway: pehle batch ke liye 5 saal tak, uske baad 3 saal
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Central exams mein EWS ko reservation milta hai, lekin age relaxation nahi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: OBC relaxation sirf Non-Creamy Layer ko milta hai, valid central-format certificate ke saath.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: Ex-servicemen: central rules ke hisaab se.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.4: Ex-Agniveers: notice ke hisaab se kuch Level 1 aur RPF posts mein relaxation.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.5: Course Completed Act Apprentices: Level 1 mein 20% reservation.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.7: One-time relaxation aage bhi milegi, aisa na maanein: har CEN notice check karein.

exams.0.currentCycle.note: Applications 8 October 2026 (graduate) aur 15 October 2026 (undergraduate) se shuru hone ki khabar hai; apni regional RRB website par CEN notices confirm karein. 2025–26 cycle (CEN 06/2025 graduate, CEN 07/2025 undergraduate) mein 8,868 posts thi.
